One freezer tags bodies to freeze frogs. Unfrozen runners touch frozen teammates to rescue them. Tongues never freeze or rescue. No automatic thaw.

60 seconds, or until all runners freeze. With two players, the first freeze ends the round. Rescue grants 1 second of protection.

Runners: 1 point/second unfrozen. Freezer: 3 points/freeze + 5 for freezing everyone with 3–8 players. Everyone starts freezer once. Highest match points wins; ties share victory.

';document.querySelector(target)!.append(details);const classic=document.createElement('details');classic.className='freeze-help';classic.innerHTML='Classic Tag rules

One frog is IT. Body contact passes IT; tongues never tag. New IT cannot tag for 1 second.

60 seconds. Earn 1 point/second not IT. Everyone starts IT once; highest total wins and ties share victory.

';document.querySelector(target)!.append(classic);}
